PostgreSQL_0:
SELECT account_id
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT amount) >= 2 AND MAX(amount) - MIN(amount) > 12000;
PostgreSQL_4:
UPDATE transactions_1k
SET amount = amount * 1.10
FROM customers
WHERE transactions_1k.custid = customers.custid AND transactions_1k.transactionid = 1
RETURNING transactions_1k.transactionid, customers.segment;
